scope_exclusions: Circuit Theorem 1.1 and all PermanentRollout targets are excluded.
Total-leaf and total-vertex consequences are excluded.
Historical admitted-PDF byte equivalence is not established.
Aggregate OpenAI Ten Proofs adjudication and output are prohibited.

decision_contract.decision_question: Does the complete admissible evidence support a family-specific MATHCERT adjudication of only the two exact encoded Permanent variable-leaf formula targets, with every recorded source-scope and authority limitation preserved?
required_evidence: Reverify the complete content-addressed authority chain through protected route registration.
Refresh isolated Lean replay of exactly the two formula targets under Lean 4.32.0.
Refresh Comparator, default Lean kernel, and Nanoda acceptance evidence.
Refresh theorem-level axiom reports and trust-boundary scan.
Reconfirm source-to-formal statement concordance for n >= 32, log base 2, complex coefficients, and constants 128/192.
Verify retained repository evidence manifest integrity.
Obtain a binding non-author specialist review on the exact execution head.
Confirm that execution remains within this approved control plan; Human Steward intervention is required only if the control plan itself must change.

competence: algebraic complexity and formula lower bounds
Lean 4 kernel replay and theorem-level axiom analysis
source-to-formal statement concordance and nonvacuity review
independence: Reviewer must not self-approve an adjudication execution they authored.
Reviewer must disclose any material conflict affecting mathematical or evidence judgment.

claim_boundary: This design-only contract defines a possible future adjudication process for the two protected Permanent variable-leaf formula targets only. It does not adjudicate or prove either theorem, issue a Cert output, certify circuit complexity, certify 256/384 gate bounds or total-size consequences, establish historical admitted-PDF byte equivalence, create aggregate OpenAI Ten Proofs authority, or authorize mathematical truth, novelty, priority, publication, patentability, product, or commercial claims. Routine stage progression may proceed under the approved control plan without separate Human Steward intervention; Human Steward intervention is required only for a control-plan change.
